authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13902 svapati gives Punjabi sauṇā and Western Pahari soṇā sleep, alongside the Awan imperative. Awan soṇā/soṇā̃ matches the regional infinitive used as a directive; nasalization and exact intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remain open. Exact survey form soṇā̃ is preserved.
